envelope.description: Build active temporary canaries with labelled controls

body.title: Build active temporary canaries with labelled controls
body.summary: Replace shadow marker files with actual private project discovery settings, hooks, CLAUDE.md, MCP and local plugin components. Bind manifest/marker observations to attempt and phase. Provide fixed provider-internal positive-control setup with no real HOME/config changes or credential copies. Unavailable discovery/telemetry stays unverified.
acceptanceChecks: Canaries live in supported discovery paths and positive controls produce capability-specific native/host signals.
Inactive controls, missing instruction/plugin signals and marker silence never become exclusion evidence.
Fixture components remain private and harmless; real config/auth/repo untouched, foreign identities rejected and resources cleaned.

tests.name: Project discovery canaries and labelled positive controls produce attributable host observations
Inactive controls missing native telemetry and model claims remain unverified
